title: AR Torpaq Məcəlləsinin 73-cü maddəsinin 1-hissəsinin və 75-ci maddəsinin 2-ci hissəsinin AR Mülki Məcəlləsinin 719.1 və 719.4-cü maddələri ilə əlaqəli şəkildə şərh edilməsinə dair
topic: Which rule governs the lessee's right to terminate a land lease at any time: Articles 73.1 and 75.2 of the Land Code or Article 719 of the Civil Code?
author: Elgun Jafarov

bullets.text: Article 2.5 of the Constitutional Law "On Normative Legal Acts" states that when the Civil Code conflicts with other codes reflecting civil law norms, the Civil Code is applied. However, it should be taken into account that this Constitutional Law entered into force on 17.02.2011 and it has no retroactive effect. *__Therefore, conflicts arising between legal norms (such as Land Code provisions) that came into force before 17.02.2011 cannot be resolved on the basis of the rules provided for in this Constitutional Law.__*

the elimination of the conflict regarding the current application should be implemented by applying Article 75.6 of the Land Code ("the procedure for terminating rights over land is determined by the Civil Code, __if not provided for by this Code__")

Article 75.6 of the *__Land Code unequivocally establishes that the norms of the Land Code regarding the rules for termination of all ownership and use rights on land, including the right to lease, have superior legal force in relation to the corresponding norms of the Civil Code.__*
